items.summary: Security disposition: evidence_needed fleet-wide; blocked for public exposure and security-sensitive releases; conditional for ordinary reversible growth. Evidence: fleet-doctor has no run or results; operations deploy, uptime, and error sweeps are unavailable; authentication and access boundaries, secrets exposure, runtime isolation, release/deploy controls, dependency provenance, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness are unverified. TLS evidence only shows no certificates expiring within 30 days and does not establish complete TLS safety. Compliance is technical-only: 37 pass, 16 fail, 6 unknown. No incident or exploitation is evidenced, but missing telemetry is not evidence of safety. Risk severity: high for public exposure and security-sensitive releases; medium for bounded growth that adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, new data collection, or cross-site behavior. Exact decision: retain private launch gates, continue only the existing read-only security evidence matrix, and do not create new security-sensitive implementation work or claim certification.
